name: RoboSpatial
intro: RoboSpatial 是面向机器人空间理解的 2D/3D 数据集与评测套件。它从五个室内和桌面三维数据源自动生成约 300 万条空间问答，覆盖世界、自我和物体中心参考系；RoboSpatial-Val 以 6,000 道是非与坐标预测题评估空间配置、上下文和兼容性。
build_method: 基于标定相机与三维框自动提取参考系空间关系并投影生成二维目标
task_type: 机器人空间推理, 视觉问答
eval_feature: 世界/自我/物体参考系；二元关系与坐标预测；未见扫描留出评测
scale: 约 300 万问答、100 万图像、5,000 个扫描；Val 6,000 题
build_method_en: Automatic reference-frame relation extraction from calibrated cameras and oriented 3D boxes, followed by 2D target projection
eval_feature_en: World-, ego-, and object-centric frames; binary relations and coordinate prediction; held-out unseen scans
intro_en: RoboSpatial is a 2D/3D dataset and evaluation suite for robotics spatial understanding. It automatically generates about 3 million spatial QA pairs from five indoor and tabletop 3D sources across world-, ego-, and object-centric frames; RoboSpatial-Val evaluates spatial configuration, context, and compatibility with 6,000 binary and coordinate-prediction questions.
scale_en: About 3M QA pairs, 1M images, and 5K scans; 6K validation questions
drawio_review_note: Aligned with RoboSpatial arXiv:2411.16537 Sections 3-4 and Appendix B, cross-checked against NVlabs/RoboSpatial. RoboSpatial converts ScanNet, Matterport3D, 3RScan, HOPE, and GraspNet-1B scene data into robotics-oriented spatial QA. The pipeline consumes RGB images, calibrated camera poses, oriented 3D boxes, and semantic labels; it computes spatial configuration, context, and compatibility across world-, ego-, and object-centric reference frames, then projects 3D geometry to sample 2D points or regions and adds 100k grounding QA pairs. The full resource contains about 3 million spatial QA pairs over 1 million images and 5,000 scans. RoboSpatial-Val holds out unseen scans and contains 6,000 questions, evenly split across the three relation types; yes/no questions use accuracy and coordinate predictions must lie within a reference convex hull.
